items.summary: ETM 2026 expands its scale, bringing together 1500+ delegates to advance energy innovation and commercialisation 27 OCT 2026 9:33PM by PIB Delhi The 29th Energy Technology Meet (ETM 2026) was inaugurated today at the ONGC Advanced Training Institute in Goa by Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Shri Hardeep Singh Puri.

facts.text: The three-day event brings together policymakers, industry leaders, researchers, technology providers and energy experts to discuss innovations shaping India’s energy future.
This is the largest ETM edition so far, with over 2,500 delegates, more than 250 speakers, 44 technical sessions and over 220 exhibition stalls.
GOBARdhan, the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme, has an outlay of ₹23,731 crore for FY 2026–27 to FY 2035–36 to scale up compressed biogas production and support the circular bioeconomy.

Complementing these efforts, Samudra Manthan, the National Offshore Exploration Scheme, has an approved outlay of ₹84,084 crore up to FY 2030–31 to boost oil and gas exploration in deepwater and ultra-deepwater areas and contribute to India’s long-term energy security.
